about_the_game:
LITTLE OLD ONE AND THE WITCH

The world sucks. Good, evil who even decides? The loudest voices, maybe.

So here’s you: a fragile orphan with a weird cat, trying to figure out what’s right when nothing feels right.
Every choice matters! …Okay, maybe not every choice. We don’t have that much budget yet. 😅

[Gonna put some Gif here]

A WORLD THAT REJECTED YOU

You are a fragile orphan, left alone after the world turned against you. Even your last friend. Your cat was taken by death. In desperation, you prayed for its return. Then a star fell upon its corpse… and from the ashes rose an Outer God in feline form.

Branded a witch and hunted by the villagers, you now wield the power of this otherworldly cat. This time, you will never let anyone tear you apart from your companion again.

[Gif of trailer]

UNVEIL THE CATS BEYOND THE STARS

Encounter countless Outer God cats, each with strange powers to grant the fragile orphan.
Use their blessings wisely to survive the ever-shifting horrors and turn impossible situations into your advantage.

QUESTION SOCIETY’S VALUES

Beyond combat, every event is drawn from real-world conflicts and social dilemmas. What is “good”? What is “right”? Fragile communities, clashing values, and biting satire yet never forced answers. Every encounter is an open-ended metaphor waiting for your choice.

WANDER THROUGH OTHERWORLDS

Unlock strange biomes through the memories of Outer God cats. Each new world brings fresh moral confusion and different dilemmas. Face them again, try a different choice, and discover what shocking outcomes await.

POWERS OF THE OUTER GOD CATS

Each cosmic cat grants unique powers. Mix and match their blessings to create your own synergies, forge custom playstyles, and turn desperate survival into twisted creativity.

STRANGE FRIENDS IN A CRUEL WORLD

Not everyone is out to hunt you down. Along the way, you’ll meet strange allies, eccentric, fragile, but sometimes kind enough to lend a hand. In a universe of cruelty, there are still those who care… or at least aren’t entirely wicked.

RELICS WITH HIDDEN STORIES

Collect bizarre relics tied to the events you encounter. Each one carries fragments of forgotten tales—pieces you must piece together and interpret for yourself. Discovering meaning within metaphor is part of the journey’s strange joy.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized depictions of violence, including burning at the stake, blood, and death. It also features dark themes such as persecution, moral conflict, and hostility between locals and immigrants. No sexual content or drug use is present.

  • Processor: Intel i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: It’s a roguelite Cosmic horror where you throw skills at endless enemies but with an awkward moral dilemmas, tough questions without easy answers, and bit of sarcastic humor. I’m not here to shove ideas down your throat. The world is already cruel enough. I’d rather just stay home and make games.
